chose: After twenty minutes of hearing in a row while a render is known to wait (a job named or an attempt's log seen), the transcriber hears nothing for ten minutes or until no render waits, checked before each note.
options: a 20-minute turn, then a 10-minute give, only while a render is known to wait
no bound: interactive work never waits, as invariant 2 had it
gray: It amends home-compute invariant 2 (interactive work never waits behind batch work); the owner asked that renders not be starved and the coordinator confirmed the amendment, but the minutes were a choice no check fixed. Its limits are server#1088; the owner decided a fast-tracked take skips the give (server#1090).
undo: Change transcribe::turn::TURN and GIVE, or pass Turn::unbounded() in transcribe::spawn and revert invariant 2's amendment.
